title: kilo
intro: Kilo CLI, an OpenCode fork, headless over `kilo run --format json --auto`, configured the same way through `KILO_CONFIG_CONTENT`.
notes: Installed from the GitHub release archive (the binary and its helpers in one directory, wrapped on PATH).
`-c` continues the last session in this directory; `KILO_PERMISSION='{"*":"allow"}'` answers every permission.
The four `KILO_*` switches stop the model fetch, autoupdate and telemetry.
